title: Agentic Architecture of Information Systems. The AAM/5C Model: A Reference Model for Distributed Autonomy
abstract: arXiv:2610.30221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large organizations increasingly face what this book calls the cognitive complexity wall: at the scale of hundreds of interacting components, maintaining the dependency map and reacting at the pace of incidents exceeds what a human team can deliver. This conceptual volume proposes AAM/5C, in which five capabilities (Capture, Comprehend, Choose, Coordinate, Control) are instantiated across seven logical layers, L1 to L7. A single authorization rule, R-AUT, separates who proposes, who decides and who executes: a probabilistic planner (L4) proposes; a governance layer (L6) decides under signed policies and records its verdict in a signed evaluation proof; a security layer (L5) issues a short-lived act token bound to that proof; a policy enforcement point verifies both before the target layer materializes the act. translated_title: 信息系统中的智能体架构：AAM/5C模型——分布式自主性的参考模型
translated_abstract: 大型组织日益面临本书所称的“认知复杂性之墙”：在数百个交互组件的规模下，维护依赖关系图并以事件发生的速度做出反应，已超出人类团队所能交付的能力范围。本概念性专著提出了AAM/5C模型，其中五项能力（捕获、理解、选择、协调、控制）在七个逻辑层（L1至L7）中被实例化。单一的授权规则R-AUT将提议者、决策者和执行者相互分离：概率规划器（L4）负责提议；治理层（L6）在签署的策略下做出决策，并将其裁定记录于签名的评估证明之中；安全层（L5）颁发绑定至该证明的短期行动令牌；策略执行点在目标层落实行动之前对两者进行验证。在明确的保证契约下，两条分析性命题（H7a、H8a）在构造上即成立。其十条命题中的其余部分……（原文摘要被截断）
tldr: 本书提出AAM/5C参考模型，将五项认知能力实例化于七个逻辑层，并通过单一授权规则R-AUT实现提议、决策与执行三者的分离，为大型组织中智能体信息系统的分布式自主性提供架构方案与可构造验证的保证契约。
en_tdlr: This book proposes the AAM/5C reference model, which instantiates five cognitive capabilities across seven logical layers and uses a single authorization rule (R-AUT) to separate proposing, deciding, and executing, providing an architectural solution with constructively verifiable guarantee contracts for distributed autonomy in agentic information systems at large-organization scale.
